caption:
OpenAI just cut ChatGPT model prices in half. GPT-6 Sol and Luna bring GPT-6 Astra's power to faster, cheaper models — with about half as many factual mistakes.

Already live in ChatGPT Work, Codex, the desktop app and the API.

Save this for the price + rollout breakdown.

📷 Photo: TechCrunch · CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: OpenAI cuts ChatGPT model prices in half with GPT-6 Sol and Luna.
slides.sub: Two faster, cheaper models built on GPT-6 Astra — with fewer mistakes.
slides.voiceover: OpenAI just launched two new models: GPT-6 Sol and Luna.

slides.label: What launched
slides.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna
items: The same advances behind GPT-6 Astra
For complex coding and professional work
For high-volume tasks: summarizing, extracting, Q&A
slides.voiceover: Sol handles complex coding, Luna handles fast everyday tasks.

slides.label: By the numbers
slides.title: cheaper API pricing
slides.sub: Permanent pricing, not a promo — the same cut for Sol and Luna.
slides.voiceover: Both models cost fifty percent less than their GPT-5.6 predecessors.

slides.label: API pricing
slides.title: Sol and Luna, per 1M tokens
slides.voiceover: Sol dropped to two dollars in, ten dollars out, per million tokens.

slides.label: Fewer mistakes
slides.title: as many factual errors
slides.sub: OpenAI says GPT-6 Sol roughly halves GPT-5.6 Sol's mistake rate.
slides.voiceover: OpenAI says Sol makes about half as many factual mistakes now.

slides.label: Where you already have it
slides.title: Already rolling out
items: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu plans
Free and Go users get GPT-6 Luna
slides.voiceover: It's already in ChatGPT Work, Codex, the desktop app and the API.

slides.label: Keep in mind
slides.title: Still rolling out
items: Chat interface access is a gradual rollout through the day
Free and Go users get Luna only, not Sol
Pricing is permanent, but usage limits vary by plan
slides.cta: Follow for daily AI tool news
slides.voiceover: The chat rollout is gradual, and free users get Luna, not Sol.

slides.title: Same GPT-6 quality,
lines: ChatGPT Work, Codex, or the API
slides.voiceover: That's GPT-6 Sol and Luna: same quality, half the price.
